story_role.summary: V03 source-accuracy pass for Castle Crydee, preserving the evidence-led ground plan while adding site geography, a stronger gate-courtyard-keep sequence, wall walks, kitchen-service circulation, cellars, and a more usable magician's tower route.

orientation_notes: Coordinate orientation is a practical reconstruction for the walkthrough rather than a claimed canonical map projection.
The great gate faces the road, town-below, and sea-view approach so the player can experience Crydee's threshold sequence before entering the courtyard.
The west wall remains the attack-facing wall for siege logic, while the east wall keeps the broad clearing and forest beyond.
Sailor's Grief is treated as a southward direction marker and the Six Sisters as distant western-sea horizon context viewed beyond the town approach.

validation_flags.message: This remains an evidence-led V03 walkthrough reconstruction rather than a final canon architecture lock.
All dimensions, topography, and most circulation shapes remain approximate reconstructions.
V03 adds town-below, sea-view, east-clearing, forest-edge, west-assault-field, battlements, and stronger gate-to-keep hero routes.
Vertical links were lengthened in V03 to support cleaner traversal between ground, cellar, gatehouse walk, and tower rooms.
Tower count, exact shell geometry, and exact coastal/topographic relationships still require broader review across the novel.
